Gold City's debut is celebrated warmly by 
the photography crew she works with.

However, people saw it purely as 
self-improvement to reach greater heights 
as a model— a mere side accessory to her 
modeling career.

She was left in quite a state of shock. 
Even the staff members who had known her 
for years failed to understand her true, 
heartfelt feelings.

Let's convey our heartfelt feelings to 
everyone through your running. That was 
the promise the Trainer made.
